value.rationale: The extra distance-two witness constraint disappears for every dominating set in the entire middle-graph operator family, a structural property stronger than previously established scalar equalities. It produces the complete all-cardinality semitotal-domination polynomial in edge-coverage form for arbitrary roots and complete minimum-set multiplicities for paths and cycles, distinguishing optimal configurations invisible to the known minimum numbers. The infinitely many exact objects and their counts are naturally motivated by the current semitotal graph-operator literature.
